Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Work & responsibility · Money, work & business

manager noun

also the manager, bank manager, hotel manager, branch manager, steward, foreman, executive, business executive

classical

Cic. de Or. 1.249
Cic. Caecin. 57: prōcūrātor, aliēnī jūris vicārius (Lewis & Short)

prōcūrātor, prōcūrātōris m.

noun, third declension

a manager, the agent who runs things for the owner

The owner’s manager or agent (Lewis & Short); on a farm the vīlicus worked under him.

Other words

  • vīlicus, vīlicī m. — the manager of a farm or estate; a foreman

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Cato Agr. 2.1: vīlicum vocet; Sen. Ep. 12.1: ait vīlicus

  • moderātor, moderātōris m. — a manager, a director

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 276: argentāriae moderātor, a bank manager; Traupman 343; Cic. N.D. 2.90: rēctor et moderātor tantī operis (Lewis & Short)

    Traupman’s word for a manager; a woman is moderātrīx.

Examples

  • vīlicum vocet, roget quid operis siet factum, quid restet

    let him call in his manager and ask what work has been done and what remainsCato Agr. 2.1

  • sī mandandum aliquid prōcūrātōrī … aut imperandum vīlicō est

    if some instruction has to be given to the manager … or an order to the foremanCic. de Or. 1.249

See also in charge, director, employee, management.

SourcesLewis & Short: procurator · Lewis & Short: vilicus · Lewis & Short: moderator
